newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND BEAT NATAL 39-17.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND BEAT NATAL 39-17.

text.p: The Auckland Blues beat the Natal Sharks by 39-17 (half-time 17-7) in a Super-12 match at Eden Park on Sunday.
Scorers - Auckland:- Tries: Sean Fitzpatrick, Ofisa Tonu'u, Carlos Spencer, Joeli Vidiri, penalty try; Penalties: Spencer (2); Conversions: Spencer (4)
Natal:- Tries: Kevin Putt, John Slade; Penalty: Gavin Lawless; Conversions: Lawless (2).
